fields: h, stages (or items) [{t, d, spot | icon, label, fx}]. label: a short stop name for the mono code ("Feed", "RO 1"; default the first word of t). fx: "gas" draws a few rising bubbles over that stop. optional: true (or the word to show, a string) marks a stage fitted only on some systems (DR-018 rule 2: optional equipment is never drawn as standard): its stop is drawn dashed (node ring, and the phone bend) and its mono code carries "Where fitted" (or the given word) after the label; the class is-optional is set on the stop.
best_for: WindingRoute draws a treatment train as one winding pipe across a navy band, each stage a stop on the wave with its line glyph, so the reader follows the water stage by stage.
